title: FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. INCLINE PUSH-UPS, STAIR PLANK, SIDE PLANK, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, CAT-COW, FIGURE-FOUR. ARMS AND MIDDLE FIRST, THEN WE OIL THE SPINE AND OPEN THE HIPS FOR THE WEEKEND.

script.welcome: FRIDAY, GRIMES. ARMS AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. PRESS, HOLD, BALANCE, THEN A PROPER STRETCH SO YOU WALK INTO THE WEEKEND LIKE A MAN AND NOT A FOLDED UP DECKCHAIR. LAST SESSION OF THE WEEK. DON'T YOU DARE COAST IT.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE OF THE WEEK. MAKE IT COUNT. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. WEEK DONE, GRIMES. FRIDAY IS LEFTOVERS OR OUT, AND THAT IS WHERE WEEKENDS GO TO DIE. PROTEIN FIRST, VEG SECOND, ONE DRINK NOT FOUR, AND THE CRACKERS STAY IN THE CUPBOARD. GET YOUR EVENING WALK IN. MONDAY WE WEIGH, AND I WANT TWO THIRTY ONE. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, SLIGHTLY WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. BODY ONE STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS, BELLY TIGHT. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE EDGE, ELBOWS AT ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS AWAY. SMOOTH REPS FOR 30 SECONDS; PAUSE AT THE TOP IF NEEDED.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. HANDS ON THE STEP, BODY STRAIGHT AS A RIFLE BARREL, CHEST TO THE EDGE, PUSH AWAY. NEED A BREATHER, TAKE IT AT THE TOP. NOT FACE DOWN ON MY STAIRS LIKE A DROPPED PASTY.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. ARMS EARNED THEIR KEEP. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STEP)
exercises.cue: FOREARMS ON THE 3RD STEP, ELBOWS UNDER SHOULDERS. WALK FEET BACK TO A STRAIGHT LINE. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE GLUTES, PULL THE BELLY BUTTON IN. NO SAGGING HIPS, NO PIKED BUTT. BREATHE STEADY. HOLD 12.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANK. THIRD STEP. THREE HOLDS OF TWELVE SECONDS. FOREARMS DOWN, BODY STRAIGHT, BUM TUCKED, BELLY TIGHT. TWELVE SECONDS, GRIMES. YOU'VE SAT THROUGH LONGER STAND UPS THAN THIS.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STAND UP, ROLL THE SHOULDERS.
exercises.speakDone: PLANK DONE. CORE HOLDING THE LINE. GOOD.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK (KNEE-DOWN OK)
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER, KNEES BENT AND STACKED (KNEE-DOWN IS LEGAL). LIFT THE HIPS SO SHOULDER, HIP AND KNEE MAKE A STRAIGHT LINE. DON'T LET THE HIPS DROP BACK. HOLD 5, LOWER, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEES DOWN IS ALLOWED. ELBOW UNDER THE SHOULDER, HIPS UP, STRAIGHT LINE. FIVE SECONDS. A SNEEZE TAKES LONGER. NO WHINGEING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. OBLIQUES ON NOTICE. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL ON ONE LEG, SOFT KNEE, FINGERTIPS ON THE WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. HINGE AT THE HIP, CHEST FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK, BACK FLAT, HIPS SQUARE. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CONTROL. RETURN SLOW. 5 EACH LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE, TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIP, BACK LEG REACHES BEHIND. FLAT BACK, HIPS LEVEL. FINGERTIP ON THE WALL IF YOU WOBBLE. WOBBLING IS TRAINING. FALLING OVER IS PAPERWORK.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. DOWN ON ALL FOURS. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. SLOW. A WEEK OF DESK HAS RUSTED THAT SPINE SOLID. OIL IT.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD YOUR HANDS BEHIND THE BOTTOM THIGH AND DRAW IT GENTLY TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTSIDE OF THE HIP. HEAD AND SHOULDERS DOWN. HOLD 30, SWITCH. CHAIR VERSION IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE, DRAW THE THIGH IN GENTLE, HEAD DOWN, BREATHE INTO THE HIP. THIS IS THE BIT YOU LIKE, SO DON'T RUSH IT, AND DON'T NOD OFF ON MY FLOOR.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS FRIDAY AND THE WEEK DONE. DISMISSED.
